title: weekly-sync-serving-runtime-infra-console-personal-prep-2026-12-15
body:
Weekly sync prep - Serving runtime / Infra / Console
Date: Wed 2026-12-16 10:00 PT (this doc = Evan's personal prep)
Attendees I'm expecting: Maya (SRE), Luke (Console), Priya (Platform), Sam (Infra), Tiffany (Perf), me (Evan)

Objectives for this week:
- Quick status: canary rollout + any regressions that block scale
- Decide run-of-week for autoscaling/burst test (target env + load profile)
- Console: per-route latency breakdown visual tweak and correlation with token-cost; decide short-term telemetry changes
- Open action items review (who owns what, blockers)

Agenda (rough)
1) 10:00 - 10:05: Quick sync + highlights (Maya)
   - Canary for v2-config: 60% traffic to canary; stable perf so far but seeing tail latency spikes ~p95 at 1.3s; need root cause triage.
   - Question for meeting: do we pause rollout or push canary to 80%? (Pros/cons below)
2) 10:05 - 10:20: Perf update (Tiffany)
   - Latency regression investigation: correlation with longer seq lengths on small cohort - see ENG-8423.
   - Possible suspects: kernel selection change in last kube rollout; also KV cache invalidation rate went up after 12/10.
   - Action: Priya + Tiffany to reproduce locally with seq-dist workload; target: reproduce by 12/18.
3) 10:20 - 10:35: Autoscaling & burst policy (Sam + Priya)
   - Need to pick two environments for the burst test: staging and a limited dedicated pool.
   - Proposal: test on staging (spot nodes) 12/20 with synthetic steady+burst profile (see test plan link in artifacts).
   - Action: Sam to provision test pool; Priya to add autoscaler policy config. Owners + due dates below.
4) 10:35 - 10:50: Console observability tweaks (Luke)
   - Per-route dashboards: add token-level cost column + alert for 15% cost increase week-over-week.
   - Tracing: include model-variant tag in traces (helps identify fallback variants during regression).
   - UX ask: allow route owners to pin/regression-notes to the dashboard.
5) 10:50 - 11:00: Review open action items & blockers; AOB; parking lot

Personal notes / questions I want to raise:
- For canary: if we push to 80% and see more tail, what's rollback SLA? Do we automatically fallback to previous kernel selection? (Maya)
- KV cache invalidation - is this primarily due to new prefix eviction policy? Where did that change land? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412
- Console telemetry: how heavy is adding model-variant tag for every trace? Need cost estimate + sampling strategy.

Open action items (from last week)
- [ ] Priya Reddy: add autoscaler policy draft to /infra/configs (due 2026-12-15) - status: in-progress
- [x] Luke Kim: small UX for route owner pinning (deployed to staging 12/12) - done
- [ ] Tiffany: narrow perf test harness to reproduce ENG-8423 (target 12/18) - blocked/needs env creds
- [ ] Sam: provision dedicated burst pool for 12/20 test (target 12/17) - waiting on infra quota request

New action items (assignments during this meeting)
- Priya Reddy: reproduce latency regression locally + create runbook entry if reproduced (due 2026-12-18)
- Sam Lee: provision burst pool and confirm capacity + cost estimate (due 2026-12-17)
- Tiffany Nguyen: build synthetic workload & schedule 12/20 run; capture end-to-end traces (due 2026-12-20)
- Luke Kim: add model-variant tag to trace payload in staging with 1% sample, report estimated ingestion cost (due 2026-12-22)
- Evan Chen (me): coordinate rollback plan & draft short canary decision matrix for tonight (due 2026-12-15 EOD)

Notes-to-self for discussion phrasing:
- Keep rollback argument simple: if p95 increases >20% or error rate >0.5% over 30m, rollback to previous canary and open incident.
- Emphasize cost of noisy retries when KV cache invalidations spike (customer impact + $$$).

Parking lot (not for this week's sync unless time)
- Long term: automatic kernel selection A/B testing pipeline (experimental env)
- Consolidate per-route SLOs into console and expose as code-first config

References / links to mention in meeting:
- JIRA: ENG-8423 (latency regression) - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-8423
- PR: serving-runtime kernel change - https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/412
- Canary runbook (Confluence) - confluence:Serving Runtime - Canary Runbook (page id 987654321)

Quick checklist before joining:
- Upload canary metrics snapshot to thread (I will attach p95/p99 plots)
- Ping Priya and Sam to confirm test env availability
- Add 'rollback' slide to 2min summary

Misc personal reminders:
- Follow up with security on VPC egress cost questions for dedicated burst pools (TBD)
- Draft notes for 1:1 with Maya next week re: SRE on-call bandwidth

End of prep doc.
summary: Personal prep for weekly serving-runtime/infra/console sync on 2026-12-16. Agenda, open items, owners, questions for canary decision, and test planning for autoscaling/burst.
